review: A perfect getaway and stay for a wedding at the base lodge. The property is beautiful, peaceful, and the perfect place to unplug. Waking up to the views was spectacular. review: Ryan went above and beyond to accommodate my family.   It was an amazing location!

name: Noelle
review:
Very disappointed. “Luxury Chalet” was not as advertised. At check-in I immediately reported safety and cleanliness issues with photos. The host read the messages but never responded. The property showed signs of neglect and poor upkeep.
The kitchen floor had numerous broken, loose, smashed ceramic tiles with sharp shards and missing grout filled with dirt. Tiles lifted and crunched underfoot, a serious hazard. Refrigerator, counters, patio windows were all smeared and grimy. The ice dispenser shoot had visible black/green Mold buildup. Oven not clean. Cabinet under sink was taped shut with pieces of packing tape. Fireplace (listed amenity) had no remote to turn. Patio unshoveled and inaccessible. Dingy dark yellow Bathroom fixture filled with lint and a bunch of big dead insects. Stained carpets, loose toilet seat, dirty marked up walls, flat old discolored pillows, ceiling water stains. For the price, a huge disappointment. Did not meet basic cleanliness or safety standards.

name: Steve
review: Great place, amazing location.

name: Kimberly

name: Geof
review: super nice,  spacious home.   easy to find,  easy to get into.   The host was also very responsive!

name: Michael
review: Cozy condo. Great views of mountains and Rangely lake.

name: Nicole
review: Ryan's place was a great ski in/ski out location for a family vacation at Saddleback. The kitchen had the items we needed to make quick meals and comfy couches and chairs to lounge on when we weren't on the mountain. It was a great value in comparison to how some of the other properties in the area were priced and we felt fortunate to be able to find such a great spot that would also allow us to bring along out dog. My son was obsessed with the giant bean bag in the bunk room as well!

name: Carter
review: Tough to beat this location and view. Condo was very clean and well kept. Place was even bigger in person, very spacious condo.

name: Alan
review: Cozy place right on the mountain. Beyond gorgeous view from the porch.

name: Cole
review: Great location. Clean place.

name: Elizabeth
review: Great location! We had an enjoyable stay and were quite comfortable.

name: Mark
review: Beautiful place. good price.

name: Maury
review:
Had a great time snowboarding for a couple days at Saddleback with my sons.  We'd never been there before and would definitely return.
Ski-in/ski-out-ability is tough to beat when visiting a place like this, but since we were snowboarding, we were advised by a neighbor to hike up a little to gain altitude and to access an alternate route down before putting on our boards or face the possibility of stalling out on a flat spot not far from the nearer departure point.
Also, if you intend to prepare any meals be sure to bring all the required ingredients - there wasn't even salt and pepper on site.
Finally, the gas fireplace was tricky to light, and when lit, the flame was inconsequential; throwing little heat or light into the room.
All that aside, we were very happy with the space, location and overall accommodations and wouldn't hesitate to return.

name: Vanessa
review:
If you're looking for a cozy mountain-side cabin that's spacious, clean, and cozy, look no further. Located on Saddleback Mountain resort, it's the perfect getaway. Even though we went in the fall, staying at Saddleback was the right choice as we were able to grab grub from the resort's restaurant (the Pub at Saddleback) and avoid the drive down to Rangeley. This isn't to say that the drive isn't worth it. Rangeley is jam-packed with restaurants and cute little gift shops. (We recommend Moose Alley!)
In terms of the rental, the TV was large. The couch was comfortable. For a traveling family, having bedrooms and TV areas on two separate floors is a game changer. We don't have children, but if we did we could have sent them downstairs while we enjoyed our peace upstairs.
We brought our dog (10-pound chihuahua) with us and she loved the view, as well as the carpet, chairs, and multiple beds. Overall, it was a wonderful stay and we would give Ryan and his communication a 10/10. He truly helped make our honeymoon special.

name: Brooke
review: The place was exactly as the listing showed. For a small condo footprint it has a ton of usable space and having a washer and dryer accessible was a huge bonus. There was an issue with the water that was unavoidable by the host/space as it had to do with a maintenance error on the ski mountain itself but the host was kind enough to refund some of our first night due to the issue and ensure that property management brought us up some water. We went in the ski off season but the grounds people still were there to plow roads so it was all very easily accessible. Overall our stay was fantastic.

name: Lisa
review: Ryan’s condo is beautifully situated on the maintain with gorgeous views of surrounding lakes and mountains. Condo was comfy and clean. It is a little light on amenities, especially in the kitchen so if you are a cook, byo anything you need as only bare necessities are provided. We all enjoyed our stay and would definitely rent this property again. Reasonably priced, ski in ski out. unbeatable views.

name: Jeff
review: What a great spot!  To be honest, I thought about leaving a bad review so I’d have this place all to myself, but couldn’t do that to Ryan!   The condo was amazing… clean, extremely well maintained, great views and easy access to the lifts.  Great communication throughout the stay.  We’ll be back for sure!

name: Jasmine
review: This condo was so beautiful and way more private and spacious than I’d expect! We only stayed for one night but really enjoyed sitting on the deck with the beautiful view. The bedrooms and bathrooms were well appointed and comfortable. We hope to come back at some point for longer and with a larger group.

name: Sarah
review: Spectacular setting, cozy and well appointed condo, perfect location with a short walk to the trail that takes you right to the base lodge. Not even a slow lift ride to be right on the main high speed quad. Unbeatable views of Rangeley Lakes, spacious bedrooms and the bunk room is so perfect for kids or packing in a few extra adults. Clean and quality bathrooms. So happy to have found this gem!

name: Gemma
review: Ryan's place is BEYOND amazing. Saddleback is one of my favorite places to ski, but I had never gotten the chance to experience summer sunsets on the mountain until now. The view from the balcony truly cannot be beat, and the chalet is spacious, thoughtfully and beautifully decorated, and has everything you need for a stay. All the furniture is SO comfortable--I loved unwinding in the evening here. In addition, Ryan is such a friendly and accommodating host--all our communication back and forth was great. I hope to return!

name: Miena
review:
Ryan and Carson gave clear instructions and communication for every part of our stay.  The place was perfect for us!  The view was Awesome & the ski in and out feature at Saddleback was phenomenal!
The kitchen and bathrooms were stocked with fantastic amenities and ready for us to have the best stay! Thank you for making this part of our 20 day trip a special over the top experience!

name: Lila
review:
We stayed here for a night before hiking up Saddleback mountain. The location was gorgeous and accommodation was clean and comfortable. Lots of beds while still providing a spacious place to spend time in a group. Almost everything in this location was perfect and spotless and we would definitely stay again. We found all the pots and pans and silverware we needed to make a simple dinner. If you plan to cook, bring your own oil and other basics.
FYI for those sensitive to mold, that there were a few visible mold spots on the ceiling downstairs (it didn't impact us at all).

name: Allyson
review:
Pictures do not do the view justice.
The unit was clean, and had everything our family of 4 needed!
We are already looking at schedules of when we can visit again!

name: Michelle
review:
This condo is the perfect blank slate for adventures and we’re already looking forward to our next one! Could not believe that was the view from the deck; we half expected it to be a photo from the clubhouse or elsewhere. Absolutely stunning.
Note that there were no washcloths in the bathrooms or kitchen, so we’d bring our own next time.

name: Jackie
review: This was the perfect place to stay for exploring Saddleback Mountain. The view was fantastic and the house had everything we needed. Ryan was a very responsive host. I would definitely stay here again.

name: Sammi
review: The condo and host, Ryan were both absolutely wonderful. The place is seconds from Saddleback Ski area, and not far from Rangeley. It is absolutely gorgeous and has a great view of a lake below. We only spent one night and wish we could’ve stayed longer. Communicating with our host was easy and he was flexible. Great experience!

name: Brooklyn
review: Beautiful condo right on the mountain. The views were incredible and the home was very comfortable. My friends and I are in town for the Oktoberfest and staying here was very convenient. Ryan was very communicative and flexible with our check in which made our stay stress free and easier. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.

name: Hannah
review: Ryan’s place was great. It was beautiful and we got to catch the leaves before it was past peak. Ryan was super responsive and easy to get ahold of. We had a great stay!

name: Tiffiny
review: Ryan’s place was as described. The view was spectacular! Overall we had what we needed to cook all our meals. Plenty of space for everyone in our group to spread out. There isn’t any A/C so the upstairs became pretty warm during the day, but the mountain breeze was helpful in cooling it off during the evening. I would recommend his condo to others!

name: Jeremy
review: A great stay on Saddleback with beautiful views. Clean and the access to the mountain is excellent. We were working on the mountain, so this was super convenient and as good as you hope for when staying away for work!

name: Grace
review: This was the perfect place for a girls get away weekend! The place was beautiful, clean, and cozy and the views were unmatched. Not far away from downtown activities and restaurants, but far enough were we felt the peacefulness of being in the woods. Thank you for a wonderful stay and being so accommodating for us!

name: Jared
review: Great location. Ski on/ski out.  We have 2 young kids so we drove right down to the base which is 2 minutes away.  Unbelievable views, clean, spacious.  Note that it is a little bare-boned with respect to cooking "stuff" but there is a grocery store less than 10 minutes away.  We would 100% recommend the townhouse.

name: Lisa
review: Incredible sunset, stars on a comfortable settee on the deck.  Ryan was very responsive with inquiries.  Clean and comfortable and spectacular fall colors!

name: Taiene
review: The house has a beautiful view, but when we entered the house we realized that it had not prepared to receive us. We had a one-year-old baby with us, so he was crawling on the floor. When we realized, the baby's hands were full of animal hair and a lot of dust. So we went to look at the house, unfortunately, it was all dirty! There was a lot of dust on the carpet, it looked like it had not been vacuumed. In the bathroom, we found hair from private parts on the toilet seats. There was hair on the pillowcases, dust everywhere, spider webs. I had to lift the carpet in the living room to see if I could find the baby's nipple. When I lifted the carpet, I found so much dirt! Unfortunately, the cleaning left something to be desired. The kitchen was dirty, with marks on the refrigerator and on the countertops. The light above the kitchen table didn't work, and the circuit breaker kept tripping, so we were always inconvenienced by having to reset the circuit breaker. He refunded us the cleaning

name: Katie
review: This condo was so beautiful. The view was incredible and it had everything that we needed for a comfortable stay. Would absolutely stay here again.

name: Jen
review: Definitely need to download the app to access the house , but after getting over that small hurdle, the house was perfect! Gorgeous location with stunning view. Super comfortable beds and close to town and hiking trails. Definitely recommend!

name: Emily
review: We had such a lovely, long weekend! The lodging was even better than expected, and the view was unsurpassed. Easy access to the ski trails, more than enough room for a family of 5, and well provisioned accommodations made this a great experience. We look forward to another visit next winter! Thank you!

review: Ryan was really helpful to locate the house. The place is absolutely gorgeous, its a new house and looks very updated. The best part is the view of the lake and the mountains from the house. I wish i could have spent more time over there.

review:

With that said, we would stay again because the place was clean, the host was super nice and the location is FABULOUS! We will just bring a lot more next year so we can cook and eat in!
